title: Deposit Defense Move-Out Planner
oneLiner: A renter protection workspace that helps tenants document apartment condition, price likely deductions, and negotiate deposit returns before the landlord controls the story.
targetUser: Renters preparing to move out within the next 45 days who want to protect their security deposit and avoid unfair repair deductions.
keyUX: Walk room by room, capture evidence, estimate deduction risk, and package a polished move-out defense packet before the final inspection.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop renter-defense workspace called Deposit Defense Move-Out Planner for tenants preparing to move out and protect their security deposit. It should help them document apartment condition, distinguish normal wear from landlord-claimed damage, estimate likely deductions, and assemble a polished negotiation packet before the final inspection. Include a deposit exposure summary, a room-by-room evidence checklist, damage versus wear comparison cards, a deduction estimate ledger, a move-out timeline, and a negotiation packet drawer. Design direction: use a premium-editorial aesthetic with warm stone and charcoal surfaces, refined legal-feeling typography, restrained luxury spacing, and polished document-forward composition so the product feels credible, composed, and financially protective rather than combative.
